Our Story

Savanna Brew Café opened in 2019 with one small espresso machine and a big dream: to celebrate Kenyan coffee. Founder Amina Otieno grew up on her grandparents' coffee farm in Nyeri and wanted to bring that flavour to the city.

Today the café supports local farmers, uses eco-friendly packaging and hosts community events every month, becoming a vibrant cultural hub in Westlands, Nairobi.

Our Core Values

  • Quality: only freshly roasted, single-origin Kenyan beans from Nyeri and Kiambu highlands.
  • Community: fair prices for farmers and a welcoming, inclusive space for all coffee lovers.
  • Sustainability: compostable cups, energy-efficient roasting, and zero-waste daily pastries.
"Coffee is more than just a beverage in Kenya; it is our heritage, our hard work, and our pride in every single cup."

— Amina Otieno, Founder & Head Roaster
